
```{r load_data_mag_filtdamr_diffe, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

load("data/data.Rdata")   # sample_metadata, genome_counts_filt, genome_metadata, genome_tree, ...
load("data/hill.Rdata")   # hill_long (id, q in {h0,h1,h2}, value)
```

```{r exclude Sample7}
# drop the outlier sample everywhere
sample_metadata   <- sample_metadata %>% filter(sample != "EHI01340")
genome_counts_filt <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  select(genome, tidyselect::any_of(sample_metadata$sample)) %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(-genome, ~ .x != 0), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)

# --- choose which Hill order to split on ----------------------------------
# use "h1" by default (exp-Shannon). Change to "h0" or "h2" if you prefer.
q_choice <- "h1"

# build Hill-wide and attach to metadata
hill_wide <- hill_long %>%
  filter(id != "EHI01340") %>%
  rename(sample = id) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = sample,
              names_from = q,
              values_from = value,
              names_glue = "env_hill_{q}")

meta_hill <- sample_metadata %>%
  left_join(hill_wide, by = "sample")

group_col <- paste0("env_group_q", substr(q_choice, 2, 2))  # env_group_q1, etc.

# tertiles → keep only Low/High (drop Mid) and fix factor order Low < High
meta_hill <- meta_hill %>%
  mutate(
    !!group_col := ggplot2::cut_number(.data[[paste0("env_hill_", q_choice)]],
                                       3, labels = c("Low","Mid","High"))
  ) %>%
  filter(.data[[group_col]] %in% c("Low","High")) %>%
  mutate(!!group_col := factor(.data[[group_col]], levels = c("Low","High")))

# keep only samples we actually have counts for
valid_samples <- intersect(meta_hill$sample, colnames(genome_counts_filt))
meta_hill     <- meta_hill %>% filter(sample %in% valid_samples)
genome_counts_filt <- genome_counts_filt %>% select(genome, all_of(valid_samples))

cat("N Low / High = ",
    sum(meta_hill[[group_col]] == "Low"), " / ",
    sum(meta_hill[[group_col]] == "High"), "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r genom_count_filt, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# compute structural zeros per genome between High and Low
low_samps  <- meta_hill$sample[meta_hill[[group_col]] == "Low"]
high_samps <- meta_hill$sample[meta_hill[[group_col]] == "High"]

sz <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    all_low0  = all(c_across(all_of(low_samps))  == 0),
    all_high0 = all(c_across(all_of(high_samps)) == 0),
    avg_low   = mean(c_across(all_of(low_samps)),  na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_high  = mean(c_across(all_of(high_samps)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(all_low0 | all_high0) %>%
  transmute(
    genome,
    present = case_when(all_low0 & !all_high0 ~ "High",
                        all_high0 & !all_low0 ~ "Low",
                        TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    average = if_else(present == "High", avg_high, avg_low)
  ) %>%
  left_join(genome_metadata %>% select(genome, phylum), by = "genome")

# Top 30 “present-only-in” genomes
if (nrow(sz)) {
  sz_top <- sz %>%
    mutate(abs_avg = abs(average)) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_avg)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 30)

  xmax <- max(sz_top$abs_avg, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1

  ggplot(sz_top,
         aes(x = average,
             y = fct_reorder(genome, average),
             fill = present)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Low = "#0072B2", High = "#D55E00"),
                      name = "Present only in") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-xmax, xmax), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Mean counts (− = Low only, + = High only)",
         y = "MAG (top 30 by |difference|)",
         title = paste0("Structural zeros — Hill ", q_choice, " (High vs Low)")) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
}
```
